draft_key_information_units.information: Record financial performance achieving all-time best net profit of EUR 29.6 million, EBITDA of EUR 89.8 million, revenue of EUR 216.6 million, and net portfolio of EUR 371.2 million with significant year-over-year growth.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 3: 'All-time best annual net profit - EUR 29.6 mln', 'EUR 89.8 mln EBITDA', 'EUR 216.6 mln Revenue, 12M 2024', 'EUR 371.2 mln Vehicle and Consumer Financing Net Portfolio'. Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss page 13 shows profit for the period EUR 29.6 mln (2023: EUR 24.5 mln).

draft_key_information_units.information: Major period-over-period changes including 16% increase in net portfolio (EUR 371.2 mln vs EUR 320.3 mln), 14.5% revenue growth (EUR 216.6 mln vs EUR 189.3 mln), 21% net profit growth (EUR 29.6 mln vs EUR 24.5 mln), and improved capitalization ratio (29.3% vs 26.1%).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 3 (portfolio and revenue figures). Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss page 13 (net profit). Note 48: Capitalization ratio 29.3% (2023: 26.1%).

draft_key_information_units.information: Key performance drivers: nearly doubled digital applications in Europe, tripling Sub-Saharan portfolio post-2023 acquisition, and early achievement (2024 vs 2025 target) of electric vehicle financing goal with 2,000 e-motorcycles financed saving ~1,000 metric tonnes CO2.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 4: 'nearly doubling the number of applications... compared to the previous year', 'tripling the combined portfolio size... during the year', 'financed nearly 2,000 electric motorcycles... reached our previously set 2025 goal a full year ahead of schedule'.

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic capital market achievement through successful EUR 29.0 million IPO in October 2024 (largest in Nasdaq Riga's history), listing on Nasdaq Riga and Frankfurt Stock Exchange, strengthening equity position and investor confidence.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 4: 'Eleving Group’s successful IPO in October—the largest in Nasdaq Riga’s history... securing EUR 29.0 mln in equity'. Note 33 details share capital increase post-IPO.

draft_key_information_units.information: Proposed dividend distribution of EUR 14.8 million (7.47% yield based on IPO price of EUR 1.70 per share) reflecting strong cash generation and commitment to shareholders.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 5 (CEO keynote): 'proposes to distribute approximately EUR 14.8 mln to its shareholders in dividends, delivering a compelling dividend yield of 7.47%...'. Note 33 confirms dividend policy and payout.

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic growth plan to nearly double business size within the next two years through three pillars: deepening existing markets, expanding product portfolio, and entering new geographies.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 5: 'Our goal is ambitious yet achievable—to nearly double the size of the business within the next two years.' Strategy section outlines three pillars.

draft_key_information_units.information: Operational milestones including completion of digital transformation with self-service platform implementation across European markets and portfolio quality improvement reducing impairment expense (EUR 42.1 mln vs EUR 39.8 mln) despite higher portfolio.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 4: 'completed the integration of digital capabilities... significantly increased demand'. Financial Statements page 13 and Note 7 show impairment expense decrease.

draft_key_information_units.information: Material post-reporting period events: EUR 40 million senior secured bond tap in March 2025 and EUR 1.15 million tax refund in North Macedonia from 2023 solidarity tax overpayment.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 47: 'On 10 March 2025 the Group has concluded the public bond offering... EUR 40 mln'... 'In March 2025 the government of North Macedonia... refund of this payment... EUR 1 151 000'.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units cover headline performance (D1), quantitative growth metrics (D2), core drivers (D3), capital structure milestones (D4), shareholder returns (D5), strategic outlook (D6), operational execution (D7), and material post-period events (D8). Units are independently omittable, avoid boilerplate, and prioritize financial performance, changes, drivers, strategy, liquidity, and post-period events as instructed. Reference summary validated key units D1-D7; D8 is material per source but not in reference example.
